#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    vector<int> cuts;
    int balance = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
            balance--;
        } else {
            balance++;
        }
        if (balance == 0) {
            cuts.push_back(abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]));
        }
    }

    sort(cuts.begin(), cuts.end());
    int sum = 0;
    int taken = 0;
    int ans = 0;
    for (int cost : cuts) {
        sum += cost;
        taken++;
        if (sum <= b) {
            ans = taken;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
